segments_b.text: The Ark was never a boat.
It was a living system designed to carry life through collapse.
We are building it now in the California desert, solar, water, animals, hands in the soil.
What you see is a homestead.
What we are growing is 40,000 acres of proof.
Come and see, the garden keeps the books.
